title: 飞翔矩阵
description: 悬置于建筑空间中的几何片体，以不同的方向、尺度与色彩形成一组空中的矩阵。
description_en: Geometric elements suspended within an architectural space form an aerial matrix of varied orientations, scales and colours.

title: 零和世界
description: 黑白球体在重复的空间中层叠、延伸，形成近乎无尽的视觉纵深。
description_en: Black and white spheres layer and extend through a repeating space, creating an almost endless visual depth.

title: 游于艺之洛伦兹吸引子
description: 红色摇杆嵌入带有绘画痕迹的木质结构。图像呈现了装置的操作界面与材料表面。
description_en: Red joysticks are embedded in a wooden structure marked with paint. The image records the interface and material surfaces of the installation.

title: 王小波与陈清扬
description: 人物、旧式显示器与数字化的自然场景共同出现，连接线在身体和设备之间展开。
description_en: A figure, an old monitor and a digitally rendered natural setting appear together, with cables extending between the body and the device.

title: 以物形诗之形式机器
subtitle: 单体
description: 屏幕中的文字、符号与图形并置于墙面的凹槽之中，构成多层的阅读界面。
title_en: Poetry Shaped by Objects: Formal Machine
description_en: Text, symbols and graphics on screens are set within recesses in a wall, forming multiple layers of reading.

title: 以物形诗之缓冲区
subtitle: 整体
description: 木质座椅、屏幕与摇杆相互组合，图像投射到墙面，让装置延伸进所在的空间。
title_en: Poetry Shaped by Objects: Buffer Zone
description_en: Wooden seats, screens and joysticks are combined with images projected onto a wall, extending the installation into its surroundings.

title: 向量空间
description: 人体形态、支架、屏幕与线缆共同构成装置。两幅图像记录了不同观看角度下的整体结构。
description_en: A human form, supports, screens and cables compose the installation. Two images record its overall structure from different viewpoints.

title: 下雨天我在朽木中做了一只AI虫子
description: 朽木的天然孔洞中嵌入像素屏幕，摇杆与按钮置于木材表面，形成自然材料与电子界面的并置。
title_en: On a Rainy Day, I Made an AI Insect in Decaying Wood
description_en: A pixel display is embedded in a natural cavity in decaying wood, with a joystick and buttons on its surface, bringing natural material and an electronic interface together.
